Carleton Wolsey Washburne 
was an American educator and education reformer. He served as the superintendent of schools in Winnetka, Illinois, United States, from 1919 to 1943 and is most notably associated with the Winnetka Plan that he developed for his district. Carleton Washburne was a writers & intellectuals from Chicago (1889-12-02, Chicago–1968-11-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
